context: Cyclos is a secure and scalable payment software. It offers a complete mobile banking platform, including SMS banking and Mobile app.

functional_requirements.sentence_text: A user can send a command to retrieve account information (the current balance and three last payments).

security_objectives.c:1: The system shall enforce access privileges that enable user to retrieve account information.; The system shall encrypt account information and store account information in encrypted format using an industry approved encryption algorithm.; The system shall transmit account information data in encrypted format to and from the authorized user.; The system shall monitor the status and location of system components that may contain unencrypted account information data.
security_objectives.i:2: The system shall ensure that all mandatory information is provided for the account information before retrieve.;The system shall protect against loss of information during retrieve.;The system shall have provision to report errors in account information during retrieve.;The system shall have provision to report errors in account information after retrieve.;The system shall have provision to correct errors in account information if errors are detected.;The system shall ensure synchronization of account information if multiple users can perform retrieve on account information simultaneously.
security_objectives.ia:2: The system shall maintain a list of accounts for each user.;The system shall authenticate users based upon PIN before allowing retrieval of account information.
security_objectives.ay:1: The system shall log every time user performs the retrieve on account information.;At a minimum, the system shall capture the following information for the log entry: user identification, timestamp, retrieve, account information, and identification of the owner of account information.;The system shall prevent all users from modifying the log entry.;The system shall allow only authorized auditors to view the log entry.

functional_requirements.sentence_text:

functional_requirements.sentence_text: The mobile phone operator delivers the message to the Cyclos SMS controler (the message might go via a SMS gateway provider but this is transparent).

security_objectives.c:1: The system shall enforce access privileges that enable mobile phone operator to deliver message.; The system shall encrypt message and store message in encrypted format using an industry approved encryption algorithm.; The system shall transmit message data in encrypted format to and from the authorized mobile phone operator.; The system shall monitor the status and location of system components that may contain unencrypted message data.
security_objectives.i:1: The system shall ensure consistent understanding of message by the mobile phone operator during delivers.;The system shall have provision to report errors in message during delivers.
security_objectives.ay:3: The system shall log every time message delivery happens.;At a minimum, the system shall capture the following information for the log entry: timestamp, message delivery;The system shall prevent all users from modifying the log entry.;The system shall allow only authorized auditors to view the log entry.

functional_requirements.sentence_text: The controller connects to Cyclos and passes the parameters.

security_objectives.c:1: The system shall enforce access privileges that enable controller to pass parameters.; The system shall encrypt parameters and store parameters in encrypted format using an industry approved encryption algorithm.; The system shall transmit parameters data in encrypted format to and from the authorized controller.; The system shall monitor the status and location of system components that may contain unencrypted parameters data.
security_objectives.i:1: The system shall ensure consistent understanding of parameters by the controller during connect and pass.;The system shall have provision to report errors in parameters during connect and pass.
security_objectives.ay:3: The system shall log every time connects happens.; At a minimum, the system shall capture the following information for the log entry: timestamp, connects; The system shall prevent all users from modifying the log entry.; The system shall allow only authorized auditors to view the log entry.

functional_requirements.sentence_text: Cyclos passes the return message to the controller, who will deliver it to the operator.

security_objectives.c:1: The system shall enforce access privileges that enable controller to deliver return message.;The system shall encrypt return message and store return message in encrypted format using an industry approved encryption algorithm.;The system shall transmit return message data in encrypted format to and from the authorized controller.;The system shall monitor the status and location of system components that may contain unencrypted return message data.
security_objectives.i:1: The system shall ensure consistent understanding of return message by the controller during deliver.;The system shall have provision to report errors in return message during deliver.
security_objectives.ay:3: The system shall log every time deliver happens.;At a minimum, the system shall capture the following information for the log entry: timestamp, deliver;The system shall prevent all users from modifying the log entry.;The system shall allow only authorized auditors to view the log entry.

functional_requirements.sentence_text: Moreover, a user can activate automatic notifications on events such as balance change, reminders of outstanding loan repayments and newly granted credit, etc.

security_objectives.c:1: The system shall enforce access privileges that enable user to activate automatic notifications.; The system shall encrypt automatic notifications and store automatic notifications in encrypted format using an industry approved encryption algorithm.; The system shall transmit automatic notifications data in encrypted format to and from the authorized user.; The system shall monitor the status and location of system components that may contain unencrypted automatic notifications data.
security_objectives.ia:2: The system shall maintain a list of accounts for each user.;The system shall authenticate users based upon PIN before allowing retrieval of account information.
security_objectives.ay:1: The system shall log every time user performs the activate on automatic notifications.;At a minimum, the system shall capture the following information for the log entry: user identification, timestamp, activate, automatic notifications, and identification of the owner of automatic notifications.;The system shall prevent all users from modifying the log entry.;The system shall allow only authorized auditors to view the log entry.

functional_requirements.sentence_text: Depending on the client configuration the alerts and notifications will be sent as internal Cyclos message, e-mail, SMS, or a combination of them.

security_objectives.c:1: The system shall enforce access privileges that enable system to send alerts and notifications.; The system shall encrypt alerts and notifications and store alerts and notifications in encrypted format using an industry approved encryption algorithm.; The system shall transmit alerts and notifications data in encrypted format to and from the authorized system.; The system shall monitor the status and location of system components that may contain unencrypted alerts and notifications data.
security_objectives.ia:2: The system shall maintain a list of accounts for each user.;The system shall authenticate users based upon PIN before allowing retrieval of account information.
security_objectives.ay:1: The system shall log every time system performs the send on alerts and notifications.;At a minimum, the system shall capture the following information for the log entry: system identification, timestamp, send, alerts and notifications, and identification of the owner of alerts and notifications.;The system shall prevent all users from modifying the log entry.;The system shall allow only authorized auditors to view the log entry.

functional_requirements.sentence_text: An administrator or broker, or the user himself can change these settings at a later stage via the web interface.

security_objectives.c:1: The system shall enforce access privileges that enable administrator or broker or user to change settings.; The system shall encrypt settings and store settings in encrypted format using an industry approved encryption algorithm.; The system shall transmit settings data in encrypted format to and from the authorized administrator or broker or user.; The system shall monitor the status and location of system components that may contain unencrypted settings data.
security_objectives.i:2: The system shall ensure that all mandatory information is provided for the settings before change.;The system shall protect against loss of information during change.;The system shall have provision to report errors in settings during change.;The system shall have provision to report errors in settings after change.;The system shall have provision to correct errors in settings if errors are detected.;The system shall ensure synchronization of settings if multiple administrator or broker or users can perform change on settings simultaneously.
security_objectives.ia:2: The system shall maintain a list of accounts for each user.;The system shall authenticate users based upon PIN before allowing retrieval of account information.
security_objectives.ay:1: The system shall log every time administrator or broker or user performs the change on settings.;At a minimum, the system shall capture the following information for the log entry: administrator or broker or user identification, timestamp, change, settings, and identification of the owner of settings.;The system shall prevent all users from modifying the log entry.;The system shall allow only authorized auditors to view the log entry.
